## What the original guide said

::: {.callout-note title="Archived explanation · not independently verified reporting"}
Transfers numerous budget and financial responsibilities from the Board of Estimates to the mayor, Finance Department, or Planning Commission; changes veto deadlines; eliminates the preliminary budget hearing process; and removes the $1 million cap on the emergency contingency fund. Some other responsibilities could be reassigned by ordinance.

**Original recommendation: NO.** This records Everett’s pre-election position, not the election result. The archive retains the full reasoning.
:::

[Read the ballot guide](../guide/index.qmd#question-f).
